operatorProperties.code:
def process(loadIdentityTheftTopThree) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df = loadIdentityTheftTopThree.copy()
    # The real header is on row 1: [Theft Type, Year, # of Reports]
    df = df.rename(
        columns={
            'Top Three Identity Theft Reports by Year': 'c0',
            'Unnamed: 1': 'c1',
            'Unnamed: 2': 'c2',
        }
    )

    # Keep only rows where c0 is a 4-digit year
    df['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['c0'], errors='coerce')
    df = df[df['Year'].between(2020, 2024, inclusive='both')].copy()

    df = df.rename(columns={'c1': 'Theft Type', 'c2': 'ReportsRaw'})
    df['# of Reports'] = (
        df['ReportsRaw']
        .astype(str)
        .str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
        .str.strip()
    )
    df['# of Reports'] = pd.to_numeric(df['# of Reports'], errors='coerce')

    out = df[['Theft Type', 'Year', '# of Reports']].dropna(subset=['Theft Type', 'Year', '# of Reports'])
    return out

operators.customDisplayName: Clean loadIdentityTheftTopThree into a tidy table by renaming columns to [c0,c1,c2], parsing Year from c0 (keep 2020-2024), mapping c1->Theft Type and c2->ReportsRaw, converting '# of Reports' to numeric by removing commas, and returning columns [Theft Type, Year, # of Reports] with non-null rows only

operatorProperties.code:
def process(cleanIdentityTheftTopThree) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df = cleanIdentityTheftTopThree.copy()

    # Keep only endpoints
    endpoints = df[df['Year'].isin([2020, 2024])]

    wide = endpoints.pivot_table(index='Theft Type', columns='Year', values='# of Reports', aggfunc='sum')
    wide = wide.rename(columns={2020: 'reports2020', 2024: 'reports2024'}).reset_index()

    # Relative growth: (2024/2020) - 1
    wide['relativeGrowth'] = (wide['reports2024'] / wide['reports2020']) - 1

    out = wide.sort_values(['relativeGrowth', 'reports2020'], ascending=[False, True]).head(1)
    return out[['Theft Type', 'relativeGrowth', 'reports2020', 'reports2024']]

operators.customDisplayName: Compute fastest relative growth in '# of Reports' from 2020 to 2024 by Theft Type: filter to Year in {2020,2024}, pivot to columns reports2020/reports2024, compute relativeGrowth=(reports2024/reports2020)-1, sort descending by relativeGrowth (tie-breaker: smaller reports2020), return top 1 Theft Type with growth metrics
